verdict.rationale: ClickUp markets a Codegen Agent and has iOS/Android apps, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows reviewing agent code diffs, leaving line-level comments from mobile, or the agent iterating on that feedback. The available pieces are adjacent only: GitHub PR sync, task and Chat comments via the API, and mobile app availability.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can review AI agent code changes and comment on specific lines from a mobile app, then have the agent iterate
